candidates.source_title: German Civilians Trained With Grenades as the War Closed In #ww2 #shorts
candidates.source_description:
As Germany’s military situation deteriorated during the final stages of World War II, the Nazi regime increasingly mobilized civilians and previously exempt men for the defence of German territory.

In October 1944, the Volkssturm was formally established, drawing heavily on males between approximately 16 and 60 who were not already serving in the German armed forces. Training was often limited and could include basic instruction in rifles, anti-tank weapons and hand grenades.
